crossRefs.note: Then Joseph couldn’t control himself before all those who stood before him, and he called out, “Cause everyone to go…
But he himself turned back from the stone idols that were by Gilgal, and said, “I have a secret message for you, O…
For everyone who does evil hates the light, and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.

people.name: Amnon
people.line: David's firstborn son, killed by Absalom

translations.web: She took the pan, and poured them out before him; but he refused to eat. Amnon said, “Have all men leave me.” Then every man went out from him.
translations.bsb: Then she brought the pan and set it down before him, but he refused to eat. “Send everyone away!” said Amnon. And everyone went out.
translations.kjv: And she took a pan, and poured them out before him; but he refused to eat. And Amnon said, Have out all men from me. And they went out every man from him.
translations.asv: And she took the pan, and poured them out before him; but he refused to eat. And Amnon said, Have out all men from me. And they went out every man from him.
